KICK — Combat Technique (Common)

A short, sharp strike at range, driven by a burst of energy rather than a weapon.

Thrown well, a Kick can send an opponent stumbling back out of range, or catch their balance wrong enough to leave them open for half a second longer than they intended.

It will not always land clean. A solid stance and good timing matter more here than raw force.

This technique does not require a free hand or a drawn weapon — only space, and the will to close it.
